## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: agent-metrics outputs interventions-per-bug with a per-category breakdown...

The system SHALL ensure that agent-metrics outputs interventions-per-bug with a per-category breakdown for a fixture dataset.

#### Scenario: agent-metrics outputs interventions-per-bug with a per-category breakdown...

WHEN `report-interventions-per-bug-and-rank-gaps` is implemented
THEN agent-metrics outputs interventions-per-bug with a per-category breakdown for a fixture dataset.

### Requirement: The report shows a time series so the trend in interventions per bug is...

The system SHALL ensure that the report shows a time series so the trend in interventions per bug is observable across periods.

#### Scenario: The report shows a time series so the trend in interventions per bug is...

WHEN `report-interventions-per-bug-and-rank-gaps` is implemented
THEN The report shows a time series so the trend in interventions per bug is observable across periods.

### Requirement: improve-harness emits at least one candidate-work stub per category that...

The system SHALL ensure that improve-harness emits at least one candidate-work stub per category that exceeds a configured frequency threshold.

#### Scenario: improve-harness emits at least one candidate-work stub per category that...

WHEN `report-interventions-per-bug-and-rank-gaps` is implemented
THEN improve-harness emits at least one candidate-work stub per category that exceeds a configured frequency threshold.
